name: InterContinental Amstel Amsterdam
insider_take: This grand dame of Amsterdam hospitality has been the city's most prestigious address since 1867, where royalty, celebrities, and dignitaries have made history along the Amstel River.
whats_special: The InterContinental Amstel Amsterdam occupies a stunning 19th-century palace with unparalleled views of the Amstel River. This legendary hotel has hosted everyone from Queen Elizabeth II to The Rolling Stones, and features Europe's largest hotel presidential suite at 600 square meters. The property's Michelin-starred La Rive restaurant and world-class spa make it Amsterdam's ultimate luxury sanctuary.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on the higher floors for breathtaking panoramas of the Amstel River and the historic Magere Brug (Skinny Bridge) – especially magical at sunset when the bridge lights illuminate the water.
dont_miss: Take a private canal cruise that departs directly from the hotel's dock, explore the nearby Hermitage Amsterdam (just a 3-minute walk), and experience high tea in the elegant Amstel Lounge while watching classic Dutch boats glide by your window.
pros: Historic palace hotel with stunning Amstel River views
Prime location near major museums and cultural attractions
Michelin-starred dining at La Rive restaurant
Elegant rooms with classic European luxury design
cons: Historic building with traditional room layouts
